inspirations.desc: A character who has an Adventure Inspiration is Inspired to go on a grand adventure and bring you back an Artifact. The artifacts gained from this Inspiration can vary wildly and can be anything from the skull of a mighty beast to a stolen heirloom.
inspirations.name: Adventure Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has an Alchemy Inspiration is Inspired to explore, purify, and create substances and metals, create elixirs, and ultimately perfect the human body and soul.
inspirations.name: Alchemy Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has an Armor Inspiration is Inspired to forge an armor or shield Artifact. This can include anything from mail to lamellar.
inspirations.name: Armor Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has an Artisan Inspiration is Inspired to apply their expert knowledge of a specific skill to produce an Artifact of great craftsmanship. Woodworkers and tailors are examples of artisans' specializations.
inspirations.name: Artisan Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Book Inspiration is Inspired to write and produce a book Artifact. The topics covered can vary wildly – as can quality – but it will result in a tome fit for royalty.
inspirations.name: Book Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Bow Inspiration is Inspired to string a bow Artifact. This can include anything from composite bows to crossbows and it will be carried in hand.
inspirations.name: Bow Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Metalsmith Inspiration is Inspired to forge something more extravagant, and smaller, than a sword or an armor. These are the artists making crowns and goblets, shining and bejeweled.
inspirations.name: Metalsmith Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Religious Inspiration is Inspired to pour their heart and soul into researching the intricacies and mysteries of Faith. They are often great reformers or leaders of religious movements. This Inspiration is very rare.
inspirations.name: Religious Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Research Inspiration is Inspired to discover new knowledge for the benefit of their Sponsor. If successful, they will improve learning within their sponsor's Dynasty or even discover a new Innovation for their culture.
inspirations.name: Research Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Weapon Inspiration is Inspired to forge a weapon Artifact. This can include anything from swords to spears and it will be carried in hand.
inspirations.name: Weapon Inspiration

inspirations.desc: A character who has a Weave Inspiration is Inspired to weave a tapestry Artifact. The imagery and scenes depicted can vary wildly – as can quality – but it will result in a tapestry fit to decorate the walls in your Royal Court.
inspirations.name: Weave Inspiration

types.desc:
Only an efficient and well-maintained court will make our realm prosper. 

Courtiers gain the Administrative Courtier traits.
types.name: Administrative Court

lines: +0.2 Character Capital County Monthly Development Growth Add /month

types.desc:
Diplomacy is key to garnering the respect of our peers and keeping the realm at peace. A pleased vassal is a loyal vassal. 

Courtiers gain the Diplomatic Courtier traits.
types.name: Diplomatic Court

types.desc:
To leave the people at court unchecked is dangerous, and we must ensure that no one can be up to no good without us knowing. 

Courtiers gain the Intrigue Courtier traits.
types.name: Intrigue Court

types.desc:
Our court rides with the strength of a thousand hooves, where the bow and the blade reign supreme. Glory is earned through conquest, and our people thrive on the spoils of war. 

Courtiers gain the Warlike Courtier traits.
types.name: Nomadic Court

types.desc:
A Court is all about attracting cultivated minds and people of exceptional skill. 

Courtiers gain the Scholarly Courtier traits.
types.name: Scholarly Court

types.desc:
At court, might makes right – and the halls shall be decked with loot and plunder! 

Courtiers gain the Warlike Courtier traits.
types.name: Tribal Court

types.desc:
A show of force is the only way to command awe and respect! Our knights and soldiers are famous for their prowess. 

Courtiers gain the Warlike Courtier traits.
types.name: Warlike Court
